#!/bin/bash
# For each func/method declared under internal/, count call sites repo-wide.
cd /bench/repo || exit 1

while IFS= read -r line; do
  file="${line%%:*}"
  rest="${line#*:}"
  lineno="${rest%%:*}"
  decl="${line#*:*:}"

  if [[ "$decl" == "func ("* ]]; then
    kind="method"
    name=$(printf '%s' "$decl" | sed -n 's/^func ([^)]*)[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9_]*\)(.*/\1/p')
  else
    kind="func"
    name=$(printf '%s' "$decl" | sed -n 's/^func \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\)(.*/\1/p')
  fi

  [[ -z "$name" ]] && continue
  [[ "$name" == "init" ]] && continue

  # all call-ish occurrences repo-wide, excluding declaration lines of same name
  all=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -E "[^A-Za-z0-9_.]${name}\(|\.${name}\(" . \
        | grep -v -E "^[^:]+:[0-9]+:func " | wc -l)
  nontest=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -E "[^A-Za-z0-9_.]${name}\(|\.${name}\(" . \
        | grep -v -E "^[^:]+:[0-9]+:func " | grep -v '_test\.go:' | wc -l)

  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s:%s\n' "$all" "$nontest" "$kind" "$name" "$file" "$lineno"
done < /tmp/decls.txt | sort -rn > /tmp/fanin.txt

head -45 /tmp/fanin.txt

The naive counts are getting skewed by common naming patterns like `New`, `Len`, `Next`, and `Validate` that appear across multiple packages. I need to look at the actual qualified calls to disambiguate them. The real candidates I'm tracking are `internal/util.GenUUID`, the `CompileToStatement` function in the filter engine, and the resource name utilities in the base package, though the list seems to be cut off.

Now I'm realizing I need a more systematic approach—counting exported functions by looking for qualified calls like `pkgname.Name(` across the repo plus bare calls within their own package, and for unexported functions just counting bare calls within their package. For methods, I'll count `.Name(` calls repo-wide but then manually verify the receiver types for the top candidates. The `base/resource_name.go` file is likely a strong contender since it probably contains functions like `ExtractMemoUIDFromName` that get used widely throughout the server. Let me start by examining that file and the other top candidates more carefully.
The naive counts are polluted by name collisions (`New`, `Len`, `Next` match unrelated symbols). Let me redo this with package-qualified counting.

The `internal/base` package only contains a variable, so that's clear. Now I need to build an accurate counter for package-level functions by looking for qualified calls like `pkg.Name(` as well as bare function calls within the same package, then handle methods separately by examining their receiver types.

#!/bin/bash
# Accurate-ish fan-in for package-level funcs declared under internal/:
#   qualified calls  pkg.Name(   repo-wide (outside the pkg)
# + bare calls       Name(       inside the declaring package only
cd /bench/repo || exit 1

grep -v '_test.go' /tmp/decls.txt | grep -v '^[^:]*:[0-9]*:func (' > /tmp/funcs.txt

while IFS= read -r line; do
  file="${line%%:*}"
  decl="${line#*:*:}"
  name=$(printf '%s' "$decl" | sed -n 's/^func \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\)(.*/\1/p')
  [[ -z "$name" || "$name" == "init" ]] && continue

  dir=$(dirname "$file")
  pkg=$(sed -n 's/^package \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\).*/\1/p' "$file" | head -1)

  qual_all=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -E "\b${pkg}\.${name}\(" . | grep -v "^\./$dir/" | wc -l)
  qual_nt=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -E "\b${pkg}\.${name}\(" . | grep -v "^\./$dir/" | grep -v '_test\.go:' | wc -l)

  bare_all=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -E "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.])${name}\(" "$dir" | grep -v -E ":[0-9]+:func " | wc -l)
  bare_nt=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -E "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.])${name}\(" "$dir" | grep -v -E ":[0-9]+:func " | grep -v '_test\.go:' | wc -l)

  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s.%s\t%s\n' \
    "$((qual_all+bare_all))" "$((qual_nt+bare_nt))" \
    "$qual_nt" "$bare_nt" "func" "$pkg" "$name" "$file"
done < /tmp/funcs.txt | sort -rn > /tmp/fanin_funcs.txt

echo "TOTAL_all TOTAL_nontest qual_nt bare_nt kind symbol file"
head -30 /tmp/fanin_funcs.txt

This is the SQL-argument/placeholder helper on the filter renderer:


Every condition-rendering path funnels through it to bind a value and get back a dialect-appropriate placeholder, which is why it dominates. All 28 call sites live in `internal/filter/render.go` itself (none in tests), spread across 14 distinct methods including `renderAccessorComparison`, `renderFunctionComparison`, `renderScalarComparison`, `renderJSONBoolComparison`, `renderTagInList`, `renderElementInCondition`, `renderScalarInCondition`, `renderRegex`, `foldedLike`, `elementPredicateSQL`, `renderTagEquals`, `renderTagStartsWith`, `buildJSONArrayLike`, and `addBoolArg`.

One caveat on the metric: if you define fan-in as *distinct calling functions* rather than total call sites, the winner flips to `(Schema).Field` in `internal/filter/schema.go:67`, with 19 call sites spread over 18 distinct callers (9 in `internal/filter/parser.go`, 9 in `internal/filter/render.go`). `addArg` has more raw calls but they cluster into fewer functions.

First, `util.GenUUID` looks like a top contender on raw grep count (28) but 19 of those are in `server/router/api/v1/test/auth_test.go` alone; its production fan-in is only 7 call sites across `server/`. Second, `(*Schedule).Next` in `internal/scheduler/parser.go` appears to have 55 callers by naive matching, but that is a false positive — nearly all `.Next(` hits outside `internal/scheduler/` are `sql.Rows.Next()` in `store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/` and an HTML tokenizer in `internal/httpgetter/html_meta.go`.
